title: Compact decision card schema contract (L12)
description: Schema invariants for the compact-card-v1 record format used at MAGMA L1. See ADR-024.

invariants.name: stable_schema_name
invariants.description: card_version='compact-card-v1' exactly. Bumping to v2 requires a new ADR and updated contract.
must: every persisted card carries card_version field
validators reject any card_version other than the contract constant
v2 introduction requires explicit ADR amendment + contract version bump

invariants.name: required_fields_present
invariants.description: All required fields are present on every card (supersedes_card_id may be null).
must: missing any required field -> validator rejects card
supersedes_card_id present even when null

invariants.name: card_hash_deterministic
invariants.description: card_hash = sha256(canonical_json(record minus card_hash field)). Two consumers computing the hash of the same card get the same value.
must: canonical JSON serialization (sorted keys, UTF-8, no whitespace) before hashing
computed twice from same record -> identical hash
consumer verifies hash before trusting card

invariants.name: source_event_hash_anchoring
invariants.description: source_event_hash MUST equal sha256 of the referenced raw MAGMA event. Validators check before trusting the card.
must: writer computes source_event_hash from the actual raw event
consumer verifies source_event_hash matches raw event hash at card boundary
mismatch -> fall back to raw replay (per ADR-021)

invariants.name: immutability
invariants.description: No in-place edits. Updates produce a new card with supersedes_card_id set.
must: no writer API to mutate an existing card_id record
delta updates produce a NEW card with new card_id and supersedes_card_id=previous_card_id
store API is append-only

invariants.name: bounded_summary
invariants.description: summary dict has at most 8 keys, each value at most 256 bytes serialized. Total card <= 512 tokens (L1 budget per ADR-021).
must: writer validates summary.keys() length <= 8
writer validates each summary value serialized length <= 256 bytes
writer validates full canonical_json(card) token count <= 512 (L1 budget)

invariants.name: allowed_decision_kinds
invariants.description: decision_kind value MUST be in the allowed set. Extensions require ADR amendment.
must: validator rejects card with decision_kind not in allowed_decision_kinds
allowed_decision_kinds is read from this contract file, not hardcoded in Python
adding a new kind requires ADR-024 amendment + contract version bump

out_of_scope: Delta-encoding for supersedes chains (L13, separate ADR)
Storage tier and zstd-at-rest (L18 / future ADR)
